variety_description: Medium duration, medium height variety developed at NDUAT, Faizabad in 1994 and released for cultivation in irrigated lowland of Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, and Odisha. Long bold heavy grains. High amylose content makes it excellent in cooking quality. Tolerant to lodging. Resistant to leaf blast and leaf blight.
